summary.en:
Ran is invited to attend a Valentine's party by a young man and Conan, being jealous, follows her. During the party, Katsuhiko, the party host, is poisoned.

Location: Minagawa household-yard

Victim: Katsuhiko Minagawa

suspects: Toshihide Wakamatsu, Kaori Sekiya, Yoshimi Watanabe, Naomichi Tanaka, and Sayuri Minagawa
suspectsZh: 若松俊秀、关谷香织、渡边芳美、田中直道与皆川小百合
